notes: Runs on 2026-11-25 to 2026-11-26 (US Pacific) against https://app.ppapi.ai/v1 on both sides. Both sides send the same request: upstream's OpenAI Responses call through LiteLLM (gpt-6-luna, thinking level high, no web search, no retries); TY2025 attaches the PDFs and streams with upstream's 14,400 s timeout. Original side: unmodified upstream at fdfe0db via parity/run_original.sh. Harbor side: taxcalcbench-direct@1.0.0 on Daytona via run_taxcalcbench_parity.yaml, with LITELLM_LOCAL_MODEL_COST_MAP=True as upstream sets it. One request in flight at a time on each side. Tasks: all 101 (parity/full_cases.txt); runs 4-5 on the original side used the same cases in the Harbor side's order (parity/full_cases_harbor_order.txt). Retries: a failed generation is left unscored and attempted again, and the first valid attempt counts; Harbor 9 of 514 trials invalid (Daytona sandbox build failures, one of them after the reply had arrived, one API stream error, 4 trials cancelled when run 4 stalled on a network outage), all retried; original 2 re-attempts. Result: the run ranges overlap on all four metrics, and still do with any one run left out. Mean gaps (Harbor minus original): 0.00, -0.20, +0.59, -0.07 points; paired per-task tests p = 1.00, 0.71, 0.82, 0.90; MSE over the four gaps 0.10, larger in 95% of 10,000 within-task shuffles. All 1,010 counted replies rescored with upstream's evaluator: 0 disagreements. Cost: $2.81 for the original side (upstream's LiteLLM estimate, the 6-case sanity check included), about the same for the Harbor side (same requests). Standard CLI agent, Harbor side only: Codex CLI 0.171.0 with gpt-6-luna, 35.0% strictly correct returns over 100 of 101 tasks (ty25-va-001 has no score: in all three attempts Codex wrote its answer, then Daytona could not build the separate verifier sandbox), $1.32. The parity files are mirrored at https://huggingface.co/datasets/gigiiii2025/taxcalcbench-parity-experiments/tree/732f335d671e6ee4c82483e17e47a78540640334/adapters/taxcalcbench while harborframework/parity-experiments is over the Hub's file limit. In adapter_pr, harbor-framework/adapters#126 is the closed first copy of this PR; the work moved to harbor-index/adapters#27.
